Cainglet announced the pregnancy Thursday, Oct. 22, on Instagram, sharing a video of herself wearing a two-piece swimsuit at the beach while rubbing her baby bump. “You know when your Tits are sitting tight again! Baby number 4 here we go [pregnancy emoji],” she wrote in the caption.
